name: nginx-multisite
description: Manages Nginx web serving for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including document roots, static content, security configuration, fail2ban, UFW, SSH hardening, sysctl settings, and development certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis service enablement, logging, authentication, and a compatibility workaround for the generated Redis configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI tutorial application backed by PostgreSQL, including Python setup, application checkout, virtual environment, dependencies, database and user creation, environment configuration, and a systemd service.
